title: Container Bookings: per-booking ceiling on roll compensation and the amount credited
content:
## Rule
For Container Bookings roll compensation, the credit before the per-booking ceiling is compared with the room left under that ceiling, which is the tier's maximum total roll compensation on one booking less the amounts of the roll compensation entries already credited on the booking, never below zero. The smaller of the two is credited, and the amount is rounded to two decimal places only at the end. When no carrier roll is still owing compensation, or the roll's position exceeds the tier's number of compensated carrier rolls, nothing is credited.

## Calculation order
1. Room left: the tier's maximum total roll compensation per booking less the compensation already credited on the booking; a negative figure counts as zero.
2. Compare the credit before the ceiling with the room left and take the smaller.
3. Round to two decimal places once, at the end.

## Worked example (hypothetical)
*Hypothetical per-booking maximum of 2000.00, for illustration only:*
| Compensation already credited | Room left | Credit before the ceiling | Amount credited |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | 2000.00 | 1080.00 | 1080.00 |
| 1500.00 | 500.00 | 1080.00 | 500.00 |
| 2000.00 | 0.00 | 1080.00 | nothing |

## Wrong reading and correct basis
| Wrong reading | Correct basis |
|---|---|
| The ceiling limits each roll separately. | The ceiling limits the total compensation on the booking; the room left deducts what was already credited. |
| The full credit before the ceiling is paid and the excess is reversed later. | Only the smaller of the credit before the ceiling and the room left is credited. |
